verdict.rationale: 1Password does store and display OTP codes (docs-20, docs-24), but the product fundamentally requires a 1Password account/subscription and cloud-synced vault to unlock and view items — community evidence explicitly states 1Password has moved away from local, non-cloud vault storage ('no native apps, no local vault storage... The VC rot has already set in'), directly contradicting the 'no vendor account required' claim. Missing for 10: any first-party or independent confirmation of a fully offline mode with no account signup/sync dependency, and no evidence disputes this gap.
